```sql
WITH superhero_colors AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.eye_colour_id, COUNT(c.id) as eye_color_count
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
    WHERE s.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    GROUP BY s.id, s.eye_colour_id
),
ranked superheroes AS (
    SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.eye_colour_id ORDER BY eye_color_count DESC) as rn
    FROM superhero_colors
)
SELECT * FROM ranked superheroes;
```

```sql
    d.driverId,
    d.number,
    d.nationality,
    s.year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.nationality) AS netherlands_count
FROM drivers d
JOIN seasons s ON d.birth_date = s.year
WHERE d.nationality IN ('Netherlands', 'Dutch')
GROUP BY 
    d.driverId,
    d.number,
    d.nationality,
    s.year
ORDER BY 
    d.nationality ASC;
```
